articles.title: India Showcases Indigenous Defence Might at World Defence Show 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth led a high-level Indian delegation from the Ministry of Defence to the World Defence Show. India's participation underscores its commitment to global defence cooperation, exploring new technologies, and strengthening strategic partnerships on the international stage. This engagement is vital for showcasing India's defence capabilities and fostering future collaborations.

articles.title: Submarine maker TKMS hits record $22 billion order backlog, raises sales outlook
articles.summary: German submarine maker TKMS has achieved a record $22 billion order backlog, significantly raising its sales outlook. This surge is attributed to a global increase in demand for warships, indicating nations are bolstering their naval capabilities amidst evolving geopolitical dynamics. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the robust growth in the international defence sector and the strategic importance of naval assets.
